items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1960-06-15
items.q: Chris- uh, Callie's love, Chris Kelly

ctx.x: That's right, in the stand. He was a real blues man who really could mix him up. But there's none beat Chris Kelly. You like Chris Kelly. He was great. I wish they had some record of him. Yes, too bad. Yeah, he- I don't think it's another man born that may have it, could play the blues like him. Chris- uh, Callie's love, Chris Kelly, could have been the composer of it. It was so great. He really was great. And he would use so much in his trumpet, could do so much with it. And he had a toilet flusher, he'd use it,…
